Subject: Your experience could make a difference

Hey [Name],

Would you consider being a guest speaker at the local event? You have practical experience people could learn from, and your thoughtful, honest approach could really connect with someone facing the same challenges you’ve worked through.

I know public speaking isn’t your favorite. You don’t need to be a polished performer—a few useful ideas and a personal story would be enough. We could ask the organizer about a short Q&A format, so it feels more like a conversation. I’d happily help you prepare and practice.

If you’re worried you have nothing special to say, remember how much your advice helped me. This could be a chance to offer that same help to someone else.

Would you be open to finding out more? No pressure to commit.

[Your Name]
question: Write a persuasive email to convince your introverted friend, who dislikes public speaking, to volunteer as a guest speaker at a local event. Use compelling arguments and address potential objections. Please be concise.
